module solution

pub fn greatest_common_divisor(a: Int, b: Int) -> Int
  requires a > 0 and b > 0
  ensures a % result == 0 and b % result == 0
  examples
    3, 5 => 1
    25, 15 => 5
  cost O(log(a + b))
{
  return if b == 0 { a } else { greatest_common_divisor(b, a % b) }
}

module solution

pub fn string_sequence(n: Int) -> String
  requires n >= 0
  examples
    0 => "0"
    5 => "0 1 2 3 4 5"
  cost O(n)
{
  let parts: List<String> = for i in 0..=n { i.to_string() }
  return parts.join(" ")
}

fn string_sequence(n: i64) -> String {
    (0..=n)
        .map(|i| i.to_string())
        .collect::<Vec<String>>()
        .join(" ")
}

module solution

pub fn is_palindrome(text: String) -> Bool
  examples
    "" => true
    "aba" => true
    "abc" => false
  cost O(text.len())
{
  let cs: List<String> = text.chars()
  return cs == cs.reverse()
}
